title: Warm Japanese Rice Donabe
description: A warm, floral, and chewy Japanese dish made with donabe and featuring nuka-pickled vegetables, served with a refreshing cider sauce. Perfect for a satvik-friendly brunch.
instructions: Heat the donabe over low heat.
Add 1 cup of sushi rice to the donabe and cook for 15 minutes, covered.
In a small saucepan, heat 1 cup of cider over low heat until warm.
To assemble, place the cooked rice into bowls, add nuka-pickled vegetables on top, and drizzle with cider sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
Serve warm, straight from the donabe.
Garnish with sesame seeds and additional nuka-pickled vegetables if desired.
Repeat as necessary to serve a crowd.
Reheat the cider sauce as needed throughout the meal.
